channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: Hooks
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: The layer that turns an instruction into a guarantee. Where each event fires in a turn, which ones can block, the exit-code contract, and the asymmetry that lets a hook tighten your permissions but never loosen them.
